answer: New identities dock at a public wharf: a 50 POA escrow deposit and a visible referral chain tracing to a sponsor. For 10 epochs any peer may challenge one; a proven fake forfeits its deposit, and its sponsor is slashed too. Honest work keeps the ember lit as the river of arrivals flows on; idle identities fade. Forging 100 costs 100x50=5,000 POA against ~200 each, a net loss near 4,800. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
